title: Rotate service.log and service-error.log
goal: Each log is rotated at a size limit, keeping a few files, without losing lines launchd still writes
acceptance: Works with launchd holding the file open (copy and truncate, or reopen)
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: size check at start and periodically, copy-truncate. Not a measurement.
